comment: Source-layout differences between our tree and Valve's that only show in debug-map paths. Each 'ours' prefix (relative to our tree) is rewritten to 'valve' (relative to Valve's src root) in the preprocessed source before the path rewrite of the tree root. Delete an entry once the owning lane moves the files.

aliases.why: retail compiled video_quicktime from src/video/quicktime_*.cpp (debug map); our tree keeps those files in video/video_quicktime/
retail sdlmgr.o has no N_SOL for the display-mode code (GLMDisplayInfo::PopulateModes etc.): Valve's sdlmgr.cpp holds it inline, our tree includes it from glmdisplaydb_linuxwin.inl
retail chromehtml includes CEF from src/thirdparty/cef (debug map N_SOL); thirdparty is a submodule here, so the CEF headers and wrapper live in external/cef
retail vpk packtest compiles against SDK 2013 headers in utils/vpk/sdk2013/ (tier1 containers and clean filesystem.h/utlsymbol.h without fork-added includes)
SDK 2013 mp stores cvartogglecheckbutton.cpp lowercase; retail hl2mp debug map has CvarToggleCheckButton.cpp
retail hl2mp (2014 SDK 2013 mp) compiles from src/..., whereas this tree keeps those files under sdk2013mp/
retail MPAFile.o debug map keeps engine/audio/../voice_codecs/minimp3/minimp3{,_ex}.h verbatim
retail audio sources include engine headers as ../../<header>.h from src/engine/audio/private/
retail keeps engine audio sources and private headers in src/engine/audio/private/, whereas this tree flattened them into engine/audio/
retail keeps engine audio public headers in src/engine/audio/public/, whereas this tree moved them to public/engine/audio/
